caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular swatch of woven fabric composed of a regular grid of small, square sections arranged in a checkered pattern. The squares alternate between a muted red color and a beige or off-white color. Each square is formed by interlacing lines that simulate the texture of woven threads, visible as horizontal and vertical strokes. The edges of the fabric are straight but slightly uneven, and the piece is centered on a plain, cream-colored background. The bottom-right corner of the background contains a handwritten name, "Sarah Ferrell Williams."
title: Woven Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
